crossRefs.note: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new?” It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich, I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any…
that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in…

translations.web: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
translations.bsb: “Worthless, worthless!” says the buyer, but on the way out, he gloats.
translations.kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
translations.asv: It is bad, it is bad, saith the buyer; But when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
